Lauretta has fair hair. Her hair hangs in two long braids down her back.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_

## History

Lauretta was raised in her faith, having conducted herself irreproachably in church since her mother first brought her as a six-month-old infant. During a church service, her quiet demeanor was disrupted when [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) dropped a caterpillar down her neck.
